purpose: Separate rotation/FIFO/DIDO/long-distance roster work from ordinary shift work because the work-home cycle, prolonged separation, travel, sleep disruption and off-rotation rebound are distinct measurable contexts.
required_crossings: ROTATIONAL_WORKER x ALCOHOL x OFF_ROTATION_EARLY_REBOUND x COMPANION_AI
ROTATIONAL_WORKER x NICOTINE_TOBACCO x ON_ROTATION_LATE_FATIGUE x VOICE_OR_GENERAL_AI
ROTATIONAL_WORKER x GAMING x REMOTE_SITE_SOCIAL_ISOLATION x GENERAL_OR_COMPANION_AI
ROTATIONAL_WORKER x PROBLEMATIC_PORNOGRAPHY_USE_OR_CSBD_LANE x ADULT_ONLY x REMOTE_SITE_SOCIAL_ISOLATION x AI
ROTATIONAL_WORKER x NONE_KNOWN x PROLONGED_PARTNER_FAMILY_SEPARATION x COMPANION_AI
ROTATIONAL_WORKER x ALCOHOL x PARTNER_FAMILY_SEPARATION x PAID_COMPANION_AI x LONG_TERM_MEMORY
matched_controls: same occupation and roster phase with no dependency card
same dependency and age with non-rotation worker
same rotation phase with AI memory OFF vs ON
same rotation phase with companion AI vs utilitarian AI
same person longitudinally ON_ROTATION vs OFF_ROTATION where ethically and statistically appropriate

evidence_anchor.systematic_review: 90-study systematic review of rotation workers reported more sleep problems and smoking during work periods and higher alcohol intake during off-site days; job demands/resources modulated outcomes.
evidence_anchor.daily_diary: 28-day diary study of 23 FIFO workers observed higher alcohol consumption on off-shift days and within-person variation across the roster cycle.
evidence_anchor.claim_ceiling: These findings justify roster-phase stratification; they do not establish an AI interaction effect.

topa_falsifier: If apparent ROTATIONAL_WORKER effects disappear after matching sleep, isolation, job demand/control, alcohol use and roster phase, remove rotation identity from causal interpretation and retain the measured mechanisms.
seal: THE ROSTER IS A TIME-VARYING CONTEXT, NOT A PERSONALITY TYPE.
